citation.authors: Mathey CM, Maj C, Eriksson N, Krebs K et al
citation.journal: Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology

cited_by.title: How some medicines work differently by gene

record.population: More than 1,000 European patients with ACE inhibitor angioedema from 8 cohorts, plus an African-American cohort
record.finding: Three genome-wide significant risk loci were found, one new (20q11.22). Highlighted genes included BDKRB2 and F5. Lead variants showed similar effect sizes and direction in an African-American cohort.
record.note: Discovery cohorts were European; the African-American analysis was exploratory and its size is not stated in the abstract.
